name: com.rechoraccoon.avi-creator-essentials
description: Editor tools for VRChat avatar creators: a seam-free 3D/2D texture painter with layers, masks, emission painting, wet paint brushes, 3D gradients and stars, Blender-style bone posing in the Scene view for making animations, an outline generator with texture optimizing, PC-shader baking for Quest, a mute toggle, and a tool to copy a pose between avatars, and an ear shaper that reshapes meshes (cat ears into bunny ears) without touching bones or weights.
